text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haa... phew...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. In light of these results, do 
you have any concerns going forward?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Me too! I totally agree!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Then let's keep going, just like this! 
Straight to the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Crown-san! Looking back on this 
Yayoi Sho, how do you feel?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It went almost exactly as envisioned. It 
was a race where we fully demonstrated the 
fruits of the prep work done with Trainer 
beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because I've been fine-tuning my 
adjustments since last winter, all for the 
sake of this spring.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In the upcoming Satsuki Sho and Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby), I believe I will 
be able to deliver an even more refined 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!)

"—On this day, people must have realized: 
Satono Crown had undeniably earned her 
right to challenge the 'Satsuki Sho.'"

With one slot in the Satsuki Sho already 
filled, who will claim the remaining 
spots—?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...The Satsuki Sho, is it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... She's really entering too, 
Crown-san.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
? Well, obviously. She's the heavy 
favorite for the Classics. Duramente-san 
is probably coming too, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Yeah. ...Right, I kind of knew 
that already.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Let's switch gears. If I can just 
make the top five in the Satsuki Sho, 
—...that'd be amazing on its own, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...That's right... ............I'm 
dreaming too much.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Even if, by some incredible miracle 
beyond belief, I was able to run in the 
Satsuki Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Those two will be there, won't they? No 
matter how high someone like me reaches, 
they're hopelessly out of reach—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...There's already a main star.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...For someone like me who has always 
lived in the shadows, there is no room to 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“...Even though I knew. So why... is it 
still—?!”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's win this!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huh... Kita-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If you want to win, let's just make it 
clear: our goal isn't just making the 
board, it's taking the win!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, as for me, you know... I might not get 
the kind of amazing praise that Kura-chan 
and the others do, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But I will absolutely, positively, 
NEEE-VER! Give up on the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The ones who win the Satsuki Sho are the 
Umamusume running in it. Every single one 
of them has a chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna give it my all! I'll do 
everything I can! All to win the Satsuki 
Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I agree with her, too. Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: S-S-Sis!? What are you doing here—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"To cheer on my little sister in the 
Mainichi Hai. If she wins there, the road 
to the Satsuki Sho is still open."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"You haven't given up either, have you? 
...Not on the Satsuki Sho, nor the 
Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! I ate three whole bowls of rice 
today, too! Now it's time to practice! 
Practice, practice! Practice, practice, 
practice!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to run together with 
Dia-chan anymore.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So that Dia-chan will keep chasing after 
my back. And so I can become just like 
Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —I'm going to win!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What's making you so frustrated, Dura?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Speak your mind. Sorting it out 
together might make it a far easier 
problem than brooding over it alone.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Big Sis Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Even back when you attended my mother's 
school, you had a tendency to brood over 
things right away."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...The crowd judges me like this: 'If 
things go well, she could win.' 'She might 
have a shot at winning the Satsuki Sho, 
too.'

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Because I failed to win my debut race. 
Because I missed out on winning a graded 
race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Because a narrow victory had become 
all that could be expected."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—How in the world does that make you "the 
strongest"?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I am merely bringing shame to 
my father, to the bloodline I hail from, 
and to all the people who have placed 
their hopes in it...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"What I must strive for is to be the 
'strongest'. And to seize the world."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The one currently closest to that title 
is— ...Gh—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...So, you believe it to be Satono Crown, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I must seize that throne for myself. With 
an overwhelming victory.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —With my own hands... I'll take her down.

A Classic Triple Crown route swirling with 
the hopes of a generation.

The first chapter, the 'Satsuki Sho', is 
about to begin—
